summary: Iteration 7 layout scroll fix verified. Sidebar and topbar remain pinned at y~0 when scrolling the main content on Dashboard, Recommendation, and History pages (desktop 1920x1080). Collapsed sidebar also stays pinned. Recommendation content fits viewport (no scroll needed); History scrolls internally (scrollHeight 1391 > client 1004) while sidebar/topbar stay pinned. Mobile (390x844) topbar with hamburger stays pinned during scroll; drawer opens and closes via close button correctly (visually confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout uses h-screen overflow-hidden shell with main flex-1 overflow-y-auto — correct pattern for pinned sidebar/topbar.
Sidebar aside is h-screen overflow-y-auto — pinned inside flex row, works well.
Topbar sits above scroll container inside the right flex column, so it remains fixed without needing 'sticky'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout is now fixed-height shell (h-screen overflow-hidden) with only <main> scrolling. Use main.scrollTop (not window.scrollY) in Playwright to scroll content. Mobile drawer remains in DOM after close (translated off-screen) — is_visible() returns True but it's visually closed; check via screenshot or translate style if needed.
